description: Patrol: Fleet Picket: radio lead-in, calls and sign-offs.

briefing: Five beacons and a wing for company. {client} thinks the picket line in {system} is about to be tested.
Fleet picket. Check the line and hold it. Expect a large response.
Patrol in force. Fly the beat and do not let anything cut the line.
success: Picket held and the line checked. {client} is satisfied.
All beacons clear and the {enemy} force broken. Well done, {captain}.
failure: The beat is lost and the line with it.
radio-beats: Five beacons on the line. Start ahead.
Picket duty. Close and hold at each beacon.
The line is marked. Nearest first.
radio-wing: Wing is with you. Stay together.
radio-picket: {enemy} picket, far side. Eight ships, two of them gunships.
Large contact. They mean to cut the line.
radio-flank: More fighters, left. They are coming in fast.
radio-ship: Frigate behind you. Do not let it reach the line.
Warship on the rear. It has escorts.
